page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m8.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 4 vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, this x86_64 architecture server provides 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and features a dedicated CPU allocation. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned at the lower end of the compute spectrum. Stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests place the server in the bottom 25% of performance. Similarly, Geekbench scores are low, with a single-core score of 915.0 and a multi-core score of 1993.0. Memory bandwidth performance is also constrained, with large-block read-only bandwidth measured at 19.83 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 18.72 GB/sec, reflecting a weak to poor performance profile.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.u0.c1m8.xlarge is its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, contrasted against its limited processing power and memory throughput. This makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-bound workloads that do not demand high CPU performance. It is suitable for lightweight database operations, caching layers with moderate throughput requirements, and general memory-intensive utility tasks rather than high-performance computing or intensive data processing.
